offer.continue: Raise your palm to continue. Both palms to start over.
intermission: A moment to breathe. Raise your palm to continue.
intermission.pick: Hold a palm over a stone to choose. Raise your palm to continue.
settings.offer.narrow: Narrow view? Palm the centre stone.
lost.final: Palm: fight again. Centre stone: end the day.
tablet.title: Tiro, day 1
story.prologue.tableau: The ford. Four mages betrayed, four collars closed.
story.ritual.septima: Septima: Kneel, Tide. The collar takes its due.
story.ritual.offer: Septima: Offer both wrists to the collar.
story.bout2.intro: Cinder hounds and the mire maw. Mind the embers.
story.bout3.intro: Brennic of the Ember. The ford remembers you both.
story.bout4.intro.corvo: Corvo of the Ember. The final.
story.bout4.intro.lio: Lio of the Gale. The final.
story.aftermath.tablet: The day is cut into stone.
story.aftermath.close: The crowd roars your name. The collar holds.
story.aftermath.close.lost: The sand drinks your blood. The collar holds.
story.closed: Rest, Cassia. The Games resume tomorrow.
